name: Default
shortDescription: OrcaSlicer 3D printer slicer streamed to the browser behind a password, with printer profiles, models and G-code kept on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Sign in with the CUSTOM_USER and PASSWORD values from the environment. This basic auth is the only protection, and anyone who signs in gets passwordless sudo inside the container. Save models and G-code under /config so they persist.
HTTPS is required; the browser desktop does not work over plain HTTP.
